objectives: Training Business Major students with the knowledge and skill of constructing Language Model from scratch and fine tune pre trained models for business applications.
content:
Introduction of Large Language Model
Up and Running with TensorFlow
Introduction with Artificial Neural Network
Training Deep Neural Nets
Tokens and Embeddings/working with text data
Looking Inside Large Language Models
Coding attention mechanism
Implementing a GTP model from scratch to generate text
Pretraining on unlabeled data
Fine Tuning for Classification
Fine Tuning to Follow Instructions/Fine Tuning Generation Models
Prompt Engineering
Semantic search and Retrieval Augmented Generation
Text Classification
Text Classification and Topic Modeling
books:
1. Aurélien Géron, Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn and TensorFlow,  O’Reilly Media, Inc., 2017
2.SEBASTIAN RASCHKA, Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), Manning Publications Co, 2025
3.Jay Alammar and Maarten Grootendorst, Hands-On Large Language Models,  O’Reilly Media, Inc.,2024
